name: Hayami Kaede
source:
A transfer student with refined features and a dignified, almost noble presence. She is the protagonist’s childhood friend. 

Although they are childhood friends, they didn’t grow up together—she was a girl who lived near his maternal grandparents' home. 

Whenever the protagonist visited his relatives with his mother, they would always play together. But one day, her family moved away. 

All this time, Kaede has continued to harbor feelings for him. When they unexpectedly reunite at her new school, long-suppressed emotions overflow, leading her to make a sudden confession.
